title_en: Gender Equality in the Chinese Workplace
note_en: Look at 地 in 希望家庭责任能更平均地分担 "hoping family duties can be shared more evenly." Chinese has three particles all pronounced de: 的 links a description to a noun, 得 follows a verb to describe its result or degree, and 地 links a description to the verb that follows it, much like the English -ly ending (平均地分担 "share evenly"). The text has another one: 简单地用新人替代 "simply replace with new hires."
